name: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
summary:
A 2D painterly fishing game for gamers who just want to fish.

Relax on the water. No crops to water. No mines to crawl. No monsters to fight. No town to manage. No energy meter telling you when to stop. Just you, your boat, a tackle box full of lures, and a lake full of nooks, crannies and fish that are really out there, moving as the day progresses, the wind blows and the the weather changes.

3 fully shipped lakes - 1: Beaver's Pond - the developer's original lake designed by hand, plus Lake Okeechobee and Santee Cooper, inspired by the real-world North American fisheries.
